title.en: The central neural system: the brain

hook.en: Your brain weighs about as much as a bag of sugar, yet it thinks, remembers, keeps you balanced on a bicycle and keeps you breathing while you sleep. Different parts do different jobs.
hook.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮಿದುಳು ಸುಮಾರು ಒಂದು ಕಿಲೋ ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ಚೀಲದಷ್ಟು ತೂಕವಿದೆ, ಆದರೂ ಯೋಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ನೆನಪಿಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಸೈಕಲ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಕಾಯುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿದ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲೂ ಉಸಿರಾಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಭಾಗಗಳು ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

narration.en: Your brain weighs about as much as a bag of sugar, yet it thinks, remembers, keeps you balanced on a bicycle and keeps you breathing while you sleep. Different parts do different jobs.
narration.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮಿದುಳು ಸುಮಾರು ಒಂದು ಕಿಲೋ ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ಚೀಲದಷ್ಟು ತೂಕವಿದೆ, ಆದರೂ ಯೋಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ನೆನಪಿಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಸೈಕಲ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಕಾಯುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿದ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲೂ ಉಸಿರಾಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಭಾಗಗಳು ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: The brain is the central information-processing organ and acts as the command and control system. It is protected by the skull and covered by the cranial meninges: an outer dura mater, a very thin middle arachnoid and an inner pia mater in contact with the brain tissue. The brain is divided into the forebrain, midbrain and hindbrain. The forebrain has the cerebrum, thalamus and hypothalamus. The cerebrum is divided by a deep cleft into left and right cerebral hemispheres connected by a tract of nerve fibres, the corpus callosum. The outer cerebral cortex is grey matter with motor areas, sensory areas and large association areas responsible for intersensory associations, memory and communication; the inner part, with myelinated fibres, is white matter. The thalamus is a major coordinating centre for sensory and motor signalling. The hypothalamus has centres that control body temperature and the urge for eating and drinking, and groups of neurosecretory cells that secrete hypothalamic hormones. The limbic system, with the hypothalamus, regulates sexual behaviour, expression of emotional reactions and motivation.
body.kn: ಮಿದುಳನ್ನು ತಲೆಬುರುಡೆ ಮತ್ತು ಡ್ಯೂರಾ ಮ್ಯಾಟರ್, ಅರಾಕ್ನಾಯ್ಡ್, ಪಯಾ ಮ್ಯಾಟರ್ ಎಂಬ ಮೂರು ಪೊರೆಗಳು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಮುಮ್ಮಿದುಳಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೆರೆಬ್ರಮ್, ಥಲಾಮಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಹೈಪೋಥಲಾಮಸ್ ಇವೆ. ಕಾರ್ಪಸ್ ಕ್ಯಾಲೋಸಮ್ ಎರಡು ಗೋಳಾರ್ಧಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೈಪೋಥಲಾಮಸ್ ದೇಹದ ಉಷ್ಣತೆ, ಹಸಿವು ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಯಾರಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Meninges: dura mater (outer), arachnoid (middle), pia mater (inner)
Corpus callosum joins the two cerebral hemispheres
Cortex = grey matter; inner tracts = white matter

narration.en: The teacher sketches the brain from the side, labels its meninges and groups its parts into forebrain, midbrain and hindbrain with their jobs.

say.en: Sketch the brain from the side: the large cerebrum on top, the folded cerebellum at the back, and the brain stem going down to the spinal cord.
The brain is wrapped in three meninges: the tough dura mater outside, the thin arachnoid, and the pia mater on the brain itself.
Group the parts: forebrain, midbrain and hindbrain. Midbrain, pons and medulla together are the brain stem.
And their jobs, from thinking to keeping us alive.

body.en: The midbrain lies between the thalamus/hypothalamus of the forebrain and the pons of the hindbrain. A canal called the cerebral aqueduct passes through it. The dorsal portion of the midbrain mainly consists of four round swellings called the corpora quadrigemina. The hindbrain has the pons, cerebellum and medulla (also called the medulla oblongata). The pons consists of fibre tracts that interconnect different regions of the brain. The cerebellum has a very convoluted surface to provide additional space for many more neurons. The medulla is connected to the spinal cord and contains centres that control respiration, cardiovascular reflexes and gastric secretions. The midbrain, pons and medulla oblongata together form the brain stem, which connects the brain to the spinal cord.
body.kn: ಮಧ್ಯಮಿದುಳಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೆರೆಬ್ರಲ್ ಅಕ್ವಿಡಕ್ಟ್ ಹಾದುಹೋಗುತ್ತದೆ; ಅದರ ಬೆನ್ನಿನ ಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಕಾರ್ಪೋರಾ ಕ್ವಾಡ್ರಿಜೆಮಿನಾ ಇವೆ. ಹಿಮ್ಮಿದುಳಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾನ್ಸ್, ಸೆರೆಬೆಲ್ಲಮ್ ಮತ್ತು ಮೆಡುಲ್ಲಾ ಇವೆ. ಮೆಡುಲ್ಲಾ ಉಸಿರಾಟ, ಹೃದಯ-ರಕ್ತನಾಳ ಪ್ರತಿವರ್ತನಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಜಠರ ಸ್ರಾವಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಮಧ್ಯಮಿದುಳು, ಪಾನ್ಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಮೆಡುಲ್ಲಾ ಸೇರಿ ಮಿದುಳು ಕಾಂಡ.

points.en: Medulla: respiration, cardiovascular reflexes, gastric secretion

problem.en: After a head injury, a patient has trouble with (a) controlling body temperature and thirst, (b) breathing regularly, and (c) connecting the two halves of the cerebrum. Which region is likely affected in each case?

steps.en: (a) Centres for body temperature and the urge for eating and drinking are in the hypothalamus.
(b) Centres controlling respiration are in the medulla oblongata.
(c) The two cerebral hemispheres are connected by the corpus callosum.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. After a head injury, a patient has trouble with (a) controlling body temperature and thirst, (b) breathing regularly, and (c) connecting the two halves of the cerebrum. Which region is likely affected in each case?

body.en: Dura, Arachnoid, Pia — "DAP": the Dura is Durable (tough, outer), the Pia is next to the brain like a Pious child holding its parent.
